sloka: क्षतज आर्द्र सवर्णाभा संध्या कालम् विना बभौ ।खरम् च अभिमुखम् नेदुः तदा घोरा मृगाः खगाः ॥३-२३-९॥
transliteration: kṣataja ārdra savarṇābhā saṁdhyā kālam vinā babhau ।kharam ca abhimukham neduḥ tadā ghorā mṛgāḥ khagāḥ ॥3-23-9॥

translations.english: Even before Sunset the twilight looked like a fresh wound. Then wild animals, birds, kankas, jackals and vultures facing towards Khara screeched, indicating danger.
